newsitem.title: USA: Texaco sees strong synergies from Shell pact.
newsitem.headline: Texaco sees strong synergies from Shell pact.

text.p: Texaco Inc expects the synergies from its proposed refining-marketing alliance with the Shell Oil Co to exceed those announced for the European alliance of BP and Mobil, Senior Vice President Glenn Tilton said Wednesday.
Chief Executive Peter Bijur told analysts Texaco expects to have a letter of intent with the Royal Dutch-Shell group subsidiary no later than the end of 1997's first quarter.
He said savings expected from the alliance will begin with the signing of an agreement indicating this could be as early as the third quarter of 1997.
Tilton said Texaco's expectation is the synergies from the alliance "will exceed those announced for British Petroleum Co Plc and Mobil Corp in Europe earlier this year."
These expectations, he added, do not include the potential for growth the alliance provides, stating this "platform for growth is the exciting part" of the current negotiations.
Bijur noted "we're not going to do Shell-Texaco unless we see a growth jump."
